strings.name: Dhanin Chearavanont
strings.role: Agribusiness and retail entrepreneur · CP Group senior chairman
strings.summary: Born into a Chinese business family in Bangkok, Dhanin studied in China and Hong Kong before entering the family business. He expanded CP from feed and livestock into food, retail and telecommunications and invested early in reform-era China. In 2017 he transferred the chairmanship and CEO position to the next generation while remaining senior chairman. His career connects Asian agricultural supply chains, family governance and cross-border investment.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones through November 13, 2026; reviewed November 15, not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Led CP Group's expansion in agriculture, livestock, food and retail, participating in Asian supply chains and cross-border investment.
